gaps.name: pinned-pixijs-browser-wiring
gaps.description: PixiJS v8 remains the renderer baseline and the adapter contract is implemented, but the current frozen pnpm lock does not contain pixi.js. A pinned workspace dependency and real browser binding must be added without breaking frozen installs.

gaps.name: browser-interaction-e2e
gaps.description: Playwright browser E2E for wheel/pinch zoom, pointer transforms, DOM text overlay, Chinese IME, keyboard focus and resize/DPR must run against the real web host.

gaps.name: gpu-texture-lifecycle-telemetry
gaps.description: Ref-count/LRU lifecycle is implemented at the resource contract layer; real Pixi/WebGL/WebGPU GPU texture allocation and release must be instrumented and leak-tested.

gaps.name: node08-standard-machine-performance-gate
gaps.description: 2k/10k structural CPU measurements exist, but near-60fps normal-scene and stress budgets require the NODE-08 standard-machine browser/GPU harness.

gaps.name: safari-macos-validation
gaps.description: Safari/macOS rendering, IME, clipboard and input behavior remain unverified until a macOS runner or manual validation lane is available.
